claims: No. 1 seed Arizona defeated No. 2 seed Purdue 79-64 in the 2026 NCAA Tournament Elite Eight on March 28, 2026
Arizona advanced to their first Final Four since 2001
The game was in San Jose, CA
Freshman Koa Peat led Arizona with 20 points
Arizona outscored Purdue 48-26 in the second half
Ivan Kharchenkov scored 18 points for Arizona
Jaden Bradley scored 14 points for Arizona
Brayden Burries scored 14 points for Arizona
Arizona will advance to the Final Four in Indianapolis
Purdue made seven 3-pointers in the first half
Purdue shot 32.1% from the field in the second half
Purdue shot 1-of-8 from 3-point range in the second half
This marked Arizona's first Final Four appearance in 25 years
Arizona snapped a streak of six consecutive Elite Eight losses
